title: Quartet migratory-insertion barriers in Fe-catalyzed hydrodisilylation
difficulty_reasons: Four fixed but nontrivial transition-state refinements must be validated by frequencies and a consistent thermochemical reference.
The Agent must independently choose and defend computational details while comparing a small candidate set.

paper.title: Iron-Catalyzed Synthesis of Unsymmetrical Disilanes
paper.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society

data.description: Four SI-labeled 68-atom quartet XYZ starting geometries for TS3A-quartet, TS3B-quartet, TS3C-quartet, and TS3D-quartet. The public reference system is defined by source-backed INT1A-sextet and 2a component identities and must be assembled/documented by the Agent.

required_deliverables.description: Validated per-candidate frequencies and relative barriers, ordering, provenance, limitations and final mechanistic conclusion.
